title: Automated Service Worker Version Sync & Billet Thumbnail Cache Busting
summary: Automates Service Worker cache versioning directly from package.json and adds versioned asset cache busting, resolving stale silver Midlander billet thumbnails and ensuring updated reference assets take effect immediately.

changes.text: Billet Thumbnail Cache Busting: linked material thumbnail URLs to the active app version (`?v=v${pkg.version}`), resolving a stale caching issue where Midlander Sword Billet and Midlander Claymore Billet displayed outdated silver beta icons instead of authentic dark in-game art.

Automated Service Worker Version Sync: introduced `scripts/sync-sw-version.mjs` wired into `predev`, `prebuild`, and `postinstall` hooks to automatically synchronize the Service Worker cache namespace (`VERSION`) with `package.json`, eliminating manual version maintenance across files.

Version-Aware Service Worker Caching: enhanced `cacheFirst` to respect version query parameters (`?v=...`) without cross-version fallback, and routed atlas manifests via `networkFirst` for immediate online updates with seamless offline fallback.
